candidate_grid_authority.pairing_rule: Only the two complete tuples above may be evaluated; no architecture/optimizer/loss/learning-rate cross-product or unregistered candidate is allowed.

training_data_boundary.formal_fa1b2de: never fit, tune, calibrate, or select
training_data_boundary.encoder_statistics: none; R3/R4 constants are fixed. A future fitted transform requires a new policy version and train-only fitting.

class_balance.cfg_01_sampler: Sample training groups with inverse class-frequency weights, capped at sampler_multiplier=3 relative to uniform; sampling is replacement-enabled, train-only, and seeded.
class_balance.cfg_02_loss_weights: For K=2, weight_c = total_training_groups/(K * training_groups_c), computed once from train groups and persisted; no validation/calibration/formal counts are used.
class_balance.zero_class_rule: A missing class in any required partition blocks release; do not synthesize labels or alter the split.

early_stopping.within_run_tie_break: earliest epoch, then lowest validation loss

randomness.sensitivity_role: Optional robustness reruns after the primary configuration/epoch is frozen; sensitivity results cannot select a different configuration for formal evaluation.
randomness.deterministic_algorithms: Request deterministic PyTorch algorithms where supported and record any backend exception in the run manifest.
randomness.phase2_separation: 314159 is reserved for the later external Phase-II evaluation and is never a training-search seed.

model_selection.selection_order: Highest primary metric, then highest secondary F1, then lowest validation loss, then lexicographically first config_id, then earliest selected epoch.

calibration.default_rule: Use argmax over the two detector logits; no probability calibration is needed for the default binary output.
calibration.optional_threshold_rule: Only if a thresholded alert is explicitly required, evaluate thresholds 0.00, 0.01, ..., 1.00 on calibration groups, select highest calibration balanced accuracy, then lowest threshold; persist the chosen threshold before formal evaluation.

manifest_identity_inputs: calibration rule and chosen value if any
checkpoint_contract.identity_hash: SHA-256 of canonical sorted-key JSON of manifest_identity_inputs
checkpoint_contract.checkpoint_sha256: SHA-256 of exact serialized checkpoint bytes; unavailable until a separately authorized training run
